description: This file defines the Label interface in the Eclipse Ditto project, representing a label used in policies. It provides static methods to create labels and retrieve associated JSON schema definitions.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: An interface representing a policy label, extending CharSequence, with static factory method and a default method to get JSON field definition.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to create a Label from a character sequence, returning a new Label instance.

methods.name: getJsonFieldDefinition
methods.description: Default method to retrieve the JSON field definition associated with this Label.
